title: Needs a decision
description: Everything that waits for a person: actions to approve with their exact payload, problems the team could not solve, proposed tasks, paused employees and finished work not merged yet.

empty.title: No approvals
empty.description: When an employee tries to send, publish, pay or delete, it will appear here.

invoice.subject: Invoice {number}
invoice.attachment: Attachment: {file} — {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, total {total} · due {due}

card.olderVersion: From an older version of the conversation
card.dryRunNotice: Dry run: approving records what would happen; nothing is actually sent.
card.editedByHuman: Edited by a human before approval.
card.rejectPlaceholder: What should change? This is written to the employee’s memory.
card.rejected: Rejected — feedback saved to the employee’s memory
card.waitingForAdmin: Waiting for an admin to decide
card.waitingForOwner: Only the Owner can decide a LIVE release, with password and authenticator code.

bash.runsWhere: Runs exactly this command in the employee's sandbox (same workspace, no host access, allow-listed network only, git hooks disabled).

git.hooksDisabled: The platform pushes this exact commit from its own copy with git hooks disabled; the employee never sees the token.

handoff.to: Creates a task for {name} when approved.
handoff.toDivision: Goes to the {name} division when approved.
handoff.noDivision: No division chosen yet: use Edit & Approve to pick one.
handoff.resumes: The waiting division task picks up again with this PRD.

skill.showBody: Show the instructions ({count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}})
skill.untrusted: Proposed by a run that read outside content (a web page, an e-mail, a file). Read the instructions carefully: if approved, the skill is saved as untrusted and read back as data.
skill.savedAs: Approving saves it in Settings → Skills, where you can switch it off, edit or delete it.

reasons.allowList: Irreversible action outside the Owner allow-list: needs your approval.
reasons.leak: The output guard found possible secrets or personal data in the payload.
reasons.taint: This run handled untrusted content (external input, a web page or tool output), so irreversible actions need approval.
reasons.demoDryRun: Demo: runs as a dry run.

preview.commitsSince: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} since the version that runs now
preview.commitsFirst: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} on top of the default branch
preview.files: {count, plural, one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
preview.filesTruncated: More files changed than are listed here.
preview.followOnApp: Follow the deploy on the app's page
preview.howItRuns: Approving deploys exactly commit {commit} to this address. The platform first checks that the branch still points at it, then builds, migrates and health-checks it; if a step fails, the version running now stays.

release.realSite: The client's real site: its visitors get this version.
release.ranInPreview: This exact commit already ran in the preview.
release.commitsSince: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} since the version live now
release.waitForWindow: Approve once the release window opens: outside it the release would be refused.
release.ownerOnly: Only the Owner decides, with password and authenticator code.
release.howItRuns: Approving builds exactly commit {commit} on the live server, migrates as shown and switches traffic over once it answers its health check; if a step fails, the version live now keeps running. Rollbacks stay possible.
release.stale: LIVE changed since this request: it was made against another live version. Reject it and ask the Developer to propose the release again.
release.expired: This request is older than 24 hours: reject it and ask the Developer again.
release.testNever: This app's preview was never tested in the browser.

test.findings: {count, plural, one {Last app test: # finding} other {Last app test: # findings}} ({when}).
test.error: The last app test ended without a result ({when}).

release.testOtherCommit: It tested commit {commit}, not this one.

waitingForRun: {count, plural, one {# more request appears} other {# more requests appear}} here once the employee finishes the current run: it cannot be decided while they are still working.

inbox.othersHeading: {count, plural, one {# other thing} other {# other things}}

kind.testFindings: {count, plural, one {App test: # finding} other {App test: # findings}}

inbox.heldExplain: An employee proposed this task. It starts only when someone starts it.
inbox.pausedExplain: Its daily budget ran out, so it stopped working. Raise the budget or resume it on its page.
inbox.mergeExplain: Finished work on its own branch. Review it and merge it into {branch}, or leave it out.
